about_blocks.text: The Operational Stress Recovery Program: A Comprehensive Residential Program for Adults
about_blocks.html: The Operational Stress Recovery Program: A Comprehensive Residential Program for Adults

about_blocks.text: The Operational Stress Recovery Program in Vernon, British Columbia, is a comprehensive interdisciplinary residential program that offers individualized treatment for adults suffering from PTSD and depression. The program includes group therapy, psycho-education, and individual therapy with a range of techniques such as cognitive behavior therapy, exposure therapy, EMDR, bio- and neurofeedback, and horse therapy. The program’s ultimate goal is to help participants achieve a healthy, balanced life.
about_blocks.html: The Operational Stress Recovery Program in Vernon, British Columbia, is a comprehensive interdisciplinary residential program that offers individualized treatment for adults suffering from PTSD and depression. The program includes group therapy, psycho-education, and individual therapy with a range of techniques such as cognitive behavior therapy, exposure therapy, EMDR, bio- and neurofeedback, and horse therapy. The program’s ultimate goal is to help participants achieve a healthy, balanced life.

about_blocks.text: In addition to the residential program, the Operational Stress Recovery Program offers a couple’s program, a specific 10-day women’s program, and a follow-up program. The couple’s program aims to help couples develop a deeper understanding of each other’s needs and improve their communication. The women’s program is designed to address specific issues that women face while dealing with PTSD and depression. The follow-up program helps clients maintain their mental health after completing the residential program.

about_blocks.text: The Operational Stress Recovery Program is located in the beautiful town of Vernon, British Columbia. Vernon is located in the midst of the Okanagan Valley, offering stunning views of the Monashee Mountains, Kalamalka Lake, and Okanagan Lake. Participants stay at The Vernon Lodge, a partnership house that is a short 10-minute walk from the clinic. Clients can enjoy private bedrooms, an indoor pool, and horseback riding, all while taking in the scenic views that surround the town.

about_blocks.text: The OSR Program is a 20-day residential program that offers high-quality PTSD educational and treatment services to individuals experiencing operational stress symptoms. Located in Vernon, BC, the program is comprehensive and multidisciplinary, providing personalized treatment to each individual. The program includes individual therapy using various techniques such as cognitive behavioural therapy, exposure, EMDR, bio- and neurofeedback, and equine therapy.

about_blocks.text: Apart from individual therapy, the program offers group therapy, experiences and psycho-education sessions, and specialized programs like a 10-Day Women’s Program (if applicable) and a dedicated Couples Program (if applicable). The outcome of participation in the program includes increased understanding of operational stress symptoms, learning new abilities to effectively manage and reduce symptoms, and an accelerated recovery that leads to an overall increase in the quality of life. OSR is one of the few programs of its kind in Canada, and it provides a unique opportunity for individuals experiencing PTSD to receive specialized and personalized treatment that can make a significant difference in their lives.

faqs.question: How long is the residential program?

answer_blocks.text: The residential program is typically eight weeks long, but the program’s length can be customized to certain needs.
answer_blocks.html: The residential program is typically eight weeks long, but the program’s length can be customized to certain needs.

faqs.question: Will my insurance cover the program's costs?

answer_blocks.text: The program accepts most major insurance carriers. However, it is recommended that you consult with your insurance provider to confirm coverage.

faqs.question: Will I be able to connect with other program participants during the program?
